conventions: For regression cells, value_as_printed is the marginal effect and p_printed_as is the parenthesized robust p-value printed beneath it (rounded to 2 decimals; '(0.00)' means p < 0.005 after rounding). Tail 'two' is an assumption: the article never states the tail; robust z-test p-values are two-sided by software default. Alpha 0.05 is conventional; the article also uses 0.10 as 'marginally significant'. Column labels: 'S' = Steepness of POW's hierarchy, 'Sm' = Sameness of POW's hierarchy; 'Cap' = captured cohort, 'Camp' = camp cohort; 'simple' = first column of the pair, 'complex' = second (full controls). All Table 4/5/6 values were checked against page images (D1_pages page-09, page-13); OCR scrambling of Pseudo R2 values ('040', '053', '0-41') resolved from the image.
